diffusicraft.settings.title: Diffusicraft Settings
diffusicraft.settings.gpuMemoryLimitMb.t: The most video memory terrain generation may use. Auto leaves 40% for the game, shaders and other programs. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.gpuIndex.tooltip: Which GPU generates terrain on a computer with several, counting from 0. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.cpuThreads.tooltip: Threads per inference run on the CPU. Fewer keep cores free for the game while terrain generates. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.halfPrecision.tool: Runs the last network in half precision on NVIDIA GPUs: about 1.2× faster, and the terrain moves by a few centimetres. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.generateAhead.tool: Computes terrain in the background where you are heading, so that chunks rarely wait for it. Turn it off if it slows the game more than waiting does. Takes effect when a world opens.
diffusicraft.settings.farTerrain.tooltip: Draws the terrain past the chunks, with what players built. Always off while Distant Horizons or Voxy is installed, which draw their own. Takes effect at once.
diffusicraft.settings.farTerrainDistance: How far the far terrain reaches. The fog closes in at its end. On a server it also ends where the server stops sending it. Takes effect at once.
diffusicraft.settings.verticalRenderDist: Section rows above and below you that the game keeps ready to draw. Auto uses the render distance; fewer save memory in tall worlds but hide terrain further above or below. No effect with Sodium. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.distantHorizonsLod: With Distant Horizons installed, fills its far terrain straight from Diffusicraft's terrain without generating chunks. Off: Distant Horizons generates chunks for it. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.voxyLods.tooltip: With Voxy installed, fills its far terrain straight from Diffusicraft's terrain where Voxy has not seen the chunks. Off: Voxy shows only the chunks it has loaded. Takes effect when a world opens.
diffusicraft.settings.serveFarTerrain.to: When you host a server or open a world to LAN, sends the far terrain to the players who have Diffusicraft. It uses your GPU or CPU as chunks do. Takes effect when the server starts.
diffusicraft.settings.shareBuilds.toolti: Shows in the far terrain sent to each player what everyone built and dug, wherever they did. Off, each player sees the terrain as generated, and what they saw themselves: what others build far away stays hidden until they go there, which makes bases harder to find. Takes effect when the server starts.
diffusicraft.settings.farTerrainRadius.t: How far from each player the far terrain is sent. Takes effect when the server starts.
diffusicraft.settings.reliefMap.tooltip: Offers the relief map through /diffusicraft map. Off takes the command away and never starts the map's web server. Takes effect at once.
diffusicraft.settings.reliefMapAddress.t: The address the map's web server listens on. 127.0.0.1 lets only this computer open the map; 0.0.0.0 lets every computer that can reach it, with a link. Takes effect when the map starts.
diffusicraft.settings.reliefMapPort.tool: The port the map's web server listens on. Empty picks a free one each time. Takes effect when the map starts.
diffusicraft.settings.reliefMapUrl.toolt: Where the map's links point, such as https://map.example.net behind a reverse proxy. Empty: the address and port the map listens on. Takes effect when the map starts.
diffusicraft.settings.showSetupScreen.to: Opens the resource screen when the game starts while something recommended is missing.
diffusicraft.settings.useSystemLibraries: Uses a CUDA toolkit and cuDNN already installed on this computer instead of downloading them. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.storagePath.toolti: Where models and runtimes are kept. Empty: a folder that every Minecraft instance on this computer shares, so they are downloaded once. A relative path starts at the game folder. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.rocmNativePath.too: The folder with your ROCm build of ONNX Runtime. Empty: runtimes/<platform>/rocm in the download folder. Takes effect after a restart.
diffusicraft.settings.resources.tooltip: Downloads the models and the GPU runtimes, and shows what is installed.
